description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProductListActivity class for an Android application. The activity manages displaying a paginated list of products, including filtering, searching, loading states, and preset management. It handles UI interactions such as search input, category and price filters, saving/deleting presets, and reacting to load states in the RecyclerView.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the product list UI, filters, presets, and load states.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Initializes listeners for preset management buttons: clearing all filters and saving/deleting presets.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Sets up UI controls for search input, category selection, and price filter chips, linking UI changes to ViewModel updates.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Synchronizes UI controls with the current filter and search state, especially when applying presets.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays chips representing active filters, allowing users to remove filters directly.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog to input a name and save the current search and filters as a preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Displays list of saved presets for selection to apply or delete.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Provides options to apply or delete a selected preset.

methods.name: confirmDeletePreset
methods.description: Confirms with the user before deleting a preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates the UI empty state message based on current search and filter state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method initializing UI, ViewModel, adapters, and observing data flows to update UI based on data state.
